apis.name: Electricity Maps
apis.why_notable: Real-time and historical carbon intensity and power mix by zone; widely used for green scheduling.

apis.name: WattTime
apis.why_notable: Marginal emissions and grid signals for carbon-aware load shifting; free research/hobby access.

apis.name: Open Charge Map
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced global EV charging location database with free API key access.

apis.name: NREL Developer Network
apis.why_notable: US DOE APIs: solar resource (NSRDB), PVWatts, AFDC EV stations, utility rates, wind.

apis.name: EIA Open Data
apis.why_notable: US Energy Information Administration official stats: electricity, petroleum, natural gas, prices.

apis.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
apis.why_notable: European electricity market data: generation, load, prices, cross-border flows via free token.

apis.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality & Weather
apis.why_notable: Free weather/solar irradiance useful for PV forecasting; no key for non-commercial use.

apis.name: Solcast
apis.why_notable: High-accuracy solar irradiance and PV power forecasts; free tier for limited API use.

apis.name: OpenEI Utility Rate Database
apis.why_notable: US utility electricity rate structures and tariffs via free OpenEI web services.

apis.name: UK Carbon Intensity API
apis.why_notable: National Grid ESO free API for GB carbon intensity forecasts by region and generation mix.

apis.name: Octopus Energy API
apis.why_notable: UK retail electricity/gas products, tariffs, and Agile half-hourly prices; public product endpoints.

apis.name: Amber Electric API
apis.why_notable: Australian wholesale-linked retail electricity prices including live and forecast intervals.

apis.name: aWATTar API
apis.why_notable: German/Austrian day-ahead hourly electricity prices for dynamic-tariff automation.

apis.name: Tibber API
apis.why_notable: Nordic/EU smart energy GraphQL API: live prices, consumption, and home energy devices.

apis.name: OpenStreetMap Overpass (charging tags)
apis.why_notable: Query amenity=charging_station worldwide; free community infrastructure for EV POI data.

apis.name: GOV.UK Fuel Prices
apis.why_notable: UK government open data of petrol/diesel prices from major retailers via free download/API feeds.

apis.name: PVOutput
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced solar PV system generation and consumption time series; free API with key.

apis.name: World Bank Climate & Energy Indicators
apis.why_notable: Country-level energy access, consumption, and emissions indicators via free Indicators API.

apis.name: co2signal (Electricity Maps)
apis.why_notable: Simple free carbon intensity by lat/lon; consumer-facing sibling of Electricity Maps.

apis.name: GridStatus.io
apis.why_notable: US ISO/RTO electricity market data (prices, load, generation) unified HTTP API.
